title: add-benchmark-lab-reporting-pipeline-v146-and-representative-runners
author: Priya Raman
release_notes: Add v146 reporting pipeline: support for multi-variant aggregation, new kernel-selection metrics, and representative workload runner updates. No user-facing API changes.
description: This PR adds benchmark-lab reporting pipeline v146 and updates representative workload runners used for profiling baselines. Motivation: deliver multi-variant aggregation and kernel-selection telemetry so the performance dashboards can show per-kernel and per-variant cost/latency breakdowns. Changes are split into a pipeline config (airflow / reporting), new telemetry exporters, a small set of runner scripts for representative workloads (chat, summarization, embedding-batch), and a migration to the normalized metrics schema. Checklist: 1) Add pipeline DAG and config; 2) Add telemetry exporters and unit tests; 3) Add representative runners with stable seeds and workload configs; 4) Add dashboard queries and example reports; 5) Run end-to-end in staging and validate outputs. Related: ENG-5412 (kernel selection metrics), ENG-5480 (reporting aggregation).
